features.name: Expert Abjurer
features.description:
When you choose this subclass at 3rd level, add two Abjuration spells from the Wizard spell list to your spellbook for free. Both spells must be level 2 or lower.

At every level thereafter when you gain a new level of spell slots, you may add one more Abjuration spell from the Wizard spell list to your spellbook for free.

features.name: Arcane Aegis
features.description:
When you cast an Abjuration spell of at least 1st level, you may siphon a portion of the spell's magic to create an Arcane Aegis. The aegis lasts until you finish a Long Rest and takes damage directed at you. The aegis has HP max of 2 × Wizard level + INT modifier. If damage exceeds the aegis's current HP, you take the remainder.

Casting another Abjuration spell of 1st level+ restores aegis HP equal to spell level × 2. You can also use a Bonus Action to expend a spell slot to restore HP equal to 2 × slot level. Once created, you cannot create a new aegis until after a Long Rest.

features.name: Aegis Extension
features.description: You may use your Reaction to have your Arcane Aegis take the damage dealt to a creature up to 30 feet from you that you can see. If the damage exceeds the current HP of the aegis, the creature takes the remainder.

payload.name: Aegis Extension
payload.description: Redirect damage from an ally within 30 ft to your Arcane Aegis.

features.name: Anti-Magician
features.description:
You always have *Dispel Magic* and *Counterspell* prepared. When you use a spell slot to cast one of these spells, if you fail to stop an opposing spell, you do not expend the spell slot.

You can also cast *Dispel Magic* as a Bonus Action, adding your Proficiency Bonus to the spell's ability check.

features.name: Resistance to Magic
features.description: You have Resistance to all damage from spells and you gain Advantage on any saving throw to resist a spell's effects.
